task.description: Hard-gate review of tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig for ISS-503 (GitHub issue #203). This is on branch feature/ADHOC-iss503-infra-20260730 (not yet merged to main). History: TEST-DESIGNER wrote the file (4 test cases per tests/specs/ISS-503.md), it compiled clean but Docker was down so it never ran; ADHOC BACKEND-DEV started services + fixed 55 unrelated pre-existing compile errors elsewhere in the suite (zero regressions, test-integration-tm 14/14) and got a live run showing TC-01 pass / TC-02-04 fail due to two bugs in the test file itself (unscoped pg_proc schema filter; stale process_definitions column list); TEST-DESIGNER reworked those two bugs plus a third latent one (tenant_id column expectation was wrong -- per-tenant schemas keep their own tenant_id/bpm_effective_tenant_id() by design, only the public schema copy is removed by GBL-084), and reports all 4 cases now genuinely pass twice in a row against a live db_test, plus test-integration-tm still 14/14. Verify this independently -- do not just trust the reported result.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement (ISS-503) has a runnable integration test file -- confirmed present
No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests without a counterpart integration test
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent
Independently re-run zig build test-integration-iss503 and confirm 4/4 pass yourself
Independently re-run zig build test-integration-tm and confirm no regression
Confirm the fixed assertions (pg_proc schema filter, process_definitions columns, tenant_id expectation) are actually correct against the live schema, not just plausible

result.summary: Independently verified on branch feature/ADHOC-iss503-infra-20260730 (commit e387b74, clean working tree, matches origin). tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig exists, covers all 4 cases (TC-ISS503-01..04) from tests/specs/ISS-503.md, opens real pg.Conn / Pool against BPM_TEST_DB_URL (no mocks/stubs, DIRECTIVE T-1 satisfied), and uses per-test UUID fixtures (randomUuidStr). No error.SkipZigTest anywhere in the file. TC-02/03 mutate the shared public.tenant table (flip LEGACY_RLS -> SCHEMA) but save/restore original storage_mode unconditionally via defer, which runs on all return paths including early error returns -- verified this is correct Zig defer semantics, not just plausible. testDbUrl() and TestHarness.init() both fail loudly (print message + return error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl) if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent -- no silent skip. Ran python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py against the file: OK, no isolation issues. Sanity-checked the three fixed assertions directly against the live db_test container (docker-compose services already healthy, no restart needed): (1) queried pg_proc live and confirmed bpm_effective_tenant_id() exists ONLY in schema tenant_default, count=0 in public -- confirming countEffectiveTenantIdFunction()'s pronamespace='public'::regnamespace filter is both present and correct, and that the unfiltered version would have false-counted the tenant_default copy; (2) ran '\d tenant_default.process_definitions' live and confirmed the real column set (id, tenant_id, name, version, status, graph, created_by, plus others) exactly matches TC-ISS503-04's INSERT statement and types; (3) confirmed tenant_default.process_definitions keeps its own NOT NULL tenant_id column backed by its own per-schema bpm_effective_tenant_id() default, so TC-04's expectation of count=1 (not 0) for that per-tenant schema is correct per GBL-084's design (only the public-schema copy is removed). Read migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql directly and confirmed all DROP COLUMN/DROP FUNCTION statements are scoped to public.* only, consistent with this. Independently ran zig build test-integration-iss503 myself twice in a row: both runs Build Summary: 4/4 tests passed, exit 0 (the POSTGRES ERROR stderr lines seen are expected output from TC-01's intentional RAISE EXCEPTION path and from tests/integration/helpers.zig best-effort cleanup of optional legacy tables like process_events/event_store/dlq that do not exist in this schema -- confirmed via tools/clean_test_db.py and helpers.zig truncateTableBestEffort, not real test failures). Independently ran zig build test-integration-tm myself: Build Summary: 14/14 tests passed, exit 0 -- no regression, satisfying ISS-504's 'regression suite green' acceptance criterion. Also ran zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set": no output, confirming clean error-set declarations. Pipeline/Playwright checks (CLAUDE.md TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR items 6-10) are not applicable: this is a backend-only integration test change for a one-shot migration (GBL-084), not a step in any sequential user-facing UI journey -- no pipeline file is relevant and none should be created for it.
